snippet.title: "Important People of History" release date trailer - "Spymaster" (SVGR Direct 2026)
snippet.description:
Play the free demo (and wishlist) the biographic visual novel "Important People of History: Presidents - George Washington" on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721820/Important_People_of_History_Presidents__George_Washington

Also, play the demo and wishlist "Important People of History: Presidents - Thomas Jefferson" here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721830/Important_People_of_History_Presidents__Thomas_Jefferson

And play the demo and wishlist "Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln" here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721840/Important_People_of_History_Presidents__Abraham_Lincoln

This trailer was shown in the Spy Video Game Rendezvous Direct 2026 here: https://youtu.be/VpUWViO9W4w
